# pve_cluster_node (Data Source)

Reads the cluster membership record of a single Proxmox VE node: its corosync node id, votes, link address, and certificate fingerprint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the cluster membership record of node pve1.
data "pve_cluster_node" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "pve1_cluster_ip" {
  value = data.pve_cluster_node.pve1.ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Name of the cluster node to read.

### Read-Only

- `config_digest` (String) Digest of the current cluster configuration.
- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint (`pve_fp`) of this node.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this data source. Equal to `node`.
- `ip` (String) Primary IP address (`pve_addr`) of this node.
- `link0` (String) Corosync link0 address (`ring0_addr`) of this node.
- `nodeid` (Number) Node id for this node in the corosync configuration.
- `preferred_node` (String) Node the cluster considers the preferred join information source.
- `votes` (Number) Number of corosync quorum votes for this node.
